explication: OptiLLM is an OpenAI-compatible inference proxy that routes chat requests through reasoning optimizations before returning responses. The principal workflow is client request → server-side approach selection → selected reasoning technique → model provider → optimized response. The README documents a broad technique catalog, while the source index and excerpts confirm selected dispatches and internal dependencies; links for unsampled features are limited to documented or indexed relationships.
